name: file-tools
description: MCP tools for local and SSH-backed file operations and command execution.

interface.shortDescription: Read, edit, patch, and run commands on local or SSH filesystems
interface.longDescription: Use MCP tools to inspect and modify text files, apply structured patches, and execute bounded commands through local or SSH-backed filesystem clients.
defaultPrompt: Inspect files in a local or SSH workspace.
Apply a precise patch to files in a selected workspace.
Run a bounded command in a local or SSH working directory.
